parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

parameters.name: router-id
parameters.explanation: 路由器的ID，通常为一个IPv4地址。

set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL type ex.command: set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL type external

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: Type of the BGP group, e.g., external

set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL peer-as.command: set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL peer-as 100
set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL peer-as.explanation: Configure BGP protocol settings by specifying the group and peer AS number

parameters.name: peer AS number
parameters.explanation: Autonomous System number of the peer

set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL neighbo.command: set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL neighbor 2001:db8:11::1
set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL neighbo.explanation: Configure BGP protocol settings by specifying a group and a neighbor IP address

parameters.name: neighbor IP address
parameters.explanation: IPv6 address of the BGP neighbor

set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL family.command: set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL family inet6 unicast
set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL family.explanation: Configure BGP protocol settings for a specific group and address family

set policy-options policy-statement IMPO.command: set policy-options policy-statement IMPORT_DIRECT term 1 from protocol direct
set policy-options policy-statement IMPO.template: set policy-options policy-statement [policy_statement] term [term_number] from protocol [protocol_type]
set policy-options policy-statement IMPO.explanation: Configures a policy statement term to match routes from a specific protocol

parameters.name: policy_statement
parameters.explanation: The name of the policy statement

parameters.name: term_number
parameters.explanation: The term number within the policy statement

parameters.name: protocol_type
parameters.explanation: The protocol type to match routes from

set policy-options policy-statement IMPO.command: set policy-options policy-statement IMPORT_DIRECT term 1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement IMPO.explanation: Configure a policy statement to accept a specific term under certain conditions

parameters.name: policy-statement name
parameters.explanation: The name of the policy statement

parameters.name: term number
parameters.explanation: The term number within the policy statement

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: The action to be taken (e.g., accept, reject)

set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL import.command: set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL import IMPORT_DIRECT
set protocols bgp group EXTERNAL import.explanation: Configure BGP protocol to set import policy for a specific group

parameters.name: import policy
parameters.explanation: Name of the import policy to apply to the BGP group
